topic: Valles Marineris vs India and the US
hook: Your India map is shorter than this Mars canyon.
title: Mars Has a Canyon Longer Than India
description:
Valles Marineris on Mars is about 4,000 km long. India is roughly 3,200 km from top to bottom, and the canyon almost crosses the United States. Part of the Mind-Bending Facts series.

#Shorts #Mars #SpaceFacts
